name: release-ops
description: Ten skills for getting a release out the door and keeping it running. npm-publish runs the full path -- preflight checks, semver bump, changelog entry, git push, publish -- and rotates an expired npm token through the browser instead of stopping to ask for a one-time code. vscode-marketplace-publish ships a VS Code extension update to the Visual Studio Marketplace, and to Open VSX if the project uses it -- preflight, version, package check, your yes, publish, then a check that it is live. version-check reads the commits since the last tag and recommends the bump. pr-wait blocks on CI checks and optionally merges when they pass. dependency-upgrade treats bulk bumps as a gated pipeline rather than a single update command, running type checks, tests, and E2E between batches. the-waiting estimates how long running CI jobs have left from their own history and spots runs stuck behind a cancelled run that never stopped. observability-setup wires health checks, uptime, logs, error tracking, and alert thresholds for a small team. incident-response gives a severity call, fixed triage order, rollback-first decision, user comms, and a blameless postmortem. customer-support-triage turns a support ticket into a classified, reproduced GitHub issue with no customer PII and a drafted reply, and checks refunds against the written policy. llm-cost-audit reconciles tracked model spend with the provider bill and ends in a savings table priced from the provider's current pricing page.
